description: Complete registry of native, system, terminal, media, communication, and web tools executable by JARVIS.

tools.name: system.torch
tools.description: Turns the device flashlight/torch on or off.

tools.name: system.volume
tools.description: Adjusts device volume (raise, lower, mute, unmute).

tools.name: system.battery
tools.description: Checks device battery level and charging state.

tools.name: system.screenshot
tools.description: Captures a device screenshot.

tools.name: media.play
tools.description: Plays requested music track, song, or artist in default media player.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Opens or launches an installed application by package name or app name.

tools.name: close_app
tools.description: Closes or stops a running application.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Starts navigation or directions to a destination address or place.

tools.name: call_contact
tools.description: Initiates a phone call or opens dialer for a phone number or contact.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends an SMS or chat message to a recipient.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads content from a local file path.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Writes text content to a local file path.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Searches for files matching a name query.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Executes a shell command in Termux, Ubuntu PRoot, or local Android shell environment.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Returns current device geographical location (latitude, longitude).

tools.name: get_battery
tools.description: Gets battery level percentage and charging state.

tools.name: get_wifi
tools.description: Gets current Wi-Fi connection status and SSID.

tools.name: system.bluetooth
tools.description: Turns the device Bluetooth on or off.

tools.name: get_bluetooth
tools.description: Gets Bluetooth enabled status and bonded devices.

tools.name: open_settings
tools.description: Opens the device Settings page or a specific sub-setting.

tools.name: open_system_page
tools.description: Opens an Android system settings or details page.

tools.name: jarvis_environment
tools.description: Discovers real system environment, storage mounts, and toolchain state.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: High-speed text-only screen capture that reads all text and coordinates on current display into /storage/emulated/0/JARVIS/workspace/screen_capture.txt. Graphic image screenshots are restricted to AGY.

tools.name: screen_info
tools.description: Reads current screen UI node tree hierarchy via Accessibility.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Performs a tap or click at screen coordinates (x, y) or text label.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Performs a scroll gesture forward or backward.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Types text into the currently focused input field.

tools.name: clipboard_get
tools.description: Reads current text from system clipboard.

tools.name: clipboard_set
tools.description: Sets or copies text to the system clipboard.

tools.name: call_history
tools.description: Reads recent calls from the Android call log.

tools.name: find_contact
tools.description: Finds contact details and phone number for a person name.

tools.name: draft_message
tools.description: Opens the default SMS app with pre-filled recipient and message without sending directly.

tools.name: open_${subName}_settings
tools.description: Opens the Android $subName settings page directly.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Deletes a local file or directory.

tools.name: rename_file
tools.description: Renames or moves a local file.

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copies a file from source to destination path.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Creates a directory/folder at the specified path.

tools.name: find_downloads
tools.description: Finds recent files in the Downloads folder.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Opens a web URL in the default browser.

tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Performs a web search in the default browser or search provider.

tools.name: app_launch_friendly
tools.description: Opens an installed Android app by its human friendly name.

tools.name: file_storage_stats
tools.description: Returns available and total storage space on device.

tools.name: read_screen_text
tools.description: High-speed text-only screen capture that reads all text and coordinates on the current display. Saves to /storage/emulated/0/JARVIS/workspace/screen_capture.txt for immediate agent reading and virtual tap targeting.

tools.name: virtual_touch
tools.description: Dispatches a virtual touch tap on the screen at coordinates (x, y) or clicks an element by visible text label. Automatically uses root fallback if accessibility is unavailable.

tools.name: virtual_scroll
tools.description: Dispatches a virtual scroll gesture on the active window.

tools.name: virtual_type
tools.description: Types text into the currently focused input field.

tools.name: press_global_key
tools.description: Presses a system navigation key (back, home, recents, notifications, quick_settings, lock_screen).

tools.name: diagnostic_ping
tools.description: Pings a network host to test connectivity.

tools.name: calc_math_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluates an arithmetic mathematical expression.

tools.name: calc_tip_calculate
tools.description: Calculates tip amount and bill split per person.

tools.name: calc_unit_convert
tools.description: Converts units of measurement (e.g. km to miles, kg to lbs, celsius to fahrenheit).

tools.name: calendar_event_create
tools.description: Creates a new calendar event with title, date, time, and optional location.

tools.name: calendar_open_day
tools.description: Opens the calendar view for today or a specific date.

tools.name: calendar_open_app
tools.description: Opens the primary calendar application.

tools.name: calendar_next_meeting
tools.description: Summarizes the next upcoming meeting on the schedule.

tools.name: calendar_quick_meeting
tools.description: Schedules a quick 30-minute sync meeting starting in 1 hour.

tools.name: camera_photo_take
tools.description: Opens camera ready to capture a photo.

tools.name: camera_video_record
tools.description: Opens camera ready to record video.

tools.name: photos_open_app
tools.description: Opens Photos or Gallery app.

tools.name: clock_alarm_set
tools.description: Sets a new alarm at a specific hour and minute with an optional label description.

tools.name: clock_alarm_list
tools.description: Opens the Clock application to view all configured alarms.

tools.name: clock_alarm_snooze
tools.description: Snoozes an active alarm.

tools.name: clock_alarm_dismiss
tools.description: Dismisses an active sounding alarm.

tools.name: clock_timer_start
tools.description: Starts a countdown timer for a specified duration in seconds or minutes.

tools.name: clock_timer_list
tools.description: Opens the active countdown timers in the clock app.

tools.name: clock_stopwatch_start
tools.description: Opens the stopwatch tab in the clock app.

tools.name: clock_world_time
tools.description: Looks up the current time, date, and timezone for any city or country in the world.

tools.name: clock_time_current
tools.description: Returns the local system time formatted naturally.

tools.name: clock_date_current
tools.description: Returns the current local date with day of week, month, day, and year.

tools.name: clock_time_difference
tools.description: Calculates the time difference in hours between the local device and a target city.

tools.name: clock_open_app
tools.description: Launches the default system clock application.

tools.name: clock_timer_preset_tea
tools.description: Starts a quick 3-minute timer preset for tea brewing.

tools.name: clock_timer_preset_pasta
tools.description: Starts a quick 10-minute timer preset for pasta cooking.

tools.name: clock_timer_preset_workout
tools.description: Starts a quick 45-minute timer preset for a workout session.

tools.name: clock_day_of_week
tools.description: Returns the day of the week for today or an offset date.

tools.name: network_wifi_toggle
tools.description: Opens Wi-Fi settings to connect or toggle Wi-Fi.

tools.name: network_bluetooth_toggle
tools.description: Toggles or configures Bluetooth state.

tools.name: network_hotspot_open
tools.description: Opens Tethering & Portable Hotspot settings.

tools.name: network_airplane_mode_open
tools.description: Opens Airplane Mode settings.

tools.name: contact_find
tools.description: Searches for a contact by name and retrieves their details.

tools.name: contact_add
tools.description: Creates a new contact card with name, phone, and optional email.

tools.name: contact_open_app
tools.description: Opens the Contacts application.

tools.name: phone_call_contact
tools.description: Initiates a phone call to a contact by name or phone number.

tools.name: phone_dial_number
tools.description: Opens the phone dialer prefilled with a phone number.

tools.name: phone_open_app
tools.description: Opens the Phone / Dialer app.

tools.name: message_send_sms
tools.description: Sends an SMS message to a contact or phone number.

tools.name: message_send_whatsapp
tools.description: Sends a message via WhatsApp.

tools.name: message_open_app
tools.description: Opens the default Messages application.

tools.name: message_share_text
tools.description: Opens the Android share sheet to share text with any messaging app.

tools.name: device_torch_toggle
tools.description: Toggles flashlight on or off.

tools.name: device_torch_on
tools.description: Turns on the flashlight/torch.

tools.name: device_torch_off
tools.description: Turns off the flashlight/torch.

tools.name: device_volume_set
tools.description: Sets device media volume percentage (0-100).

tools.name: device_volume_raise
tools.description: Increases media volume by one step.

tools.name: device_volume_lower
tools.description: Decreases media volume by one step.

tools.name: device_volume_mute
tools.description: Mutes device media sound.

tools.name: device_battery_status
tools.description: Checks battery percentage, charging state, and health.

tools.name: device_screenshot_take
tools.description: Captures an instant screenshot of the device screen.

tools.name: device_vibrate
tools.description: Vibrates the device for a specified duration in milliseconds.

tools.name: device_settings_open
tools.description: Opens Android Settings or a specific subpage.

tools.name: browser_render_app
tools.description: Generates and renders an on-demand, interactive HTML/CSS/JS mini web-app in JarvisBrowser. Use whenever a visual UI, animation, interactive simulation, chart, comparison table, or custom dashboard improves the response.

tools.name: browser_launch_app
tools.description: Launches an existing or saved JarvisBrowser app by ID, title, or search query (e.g. 'faraday', 'workout').

tools.name: browser_list_apps
tools.description: Lists all saved and permanent JarvisBrowser mini-apps in the user's library.

tools.name: browser_save_app
tools.description: Saves a temporary JarvisBrowser app permanently into the user's reusable apps library.

tools.name: browser_delete_app
tools.description: Deletes a saved JarvisBrowser mini-app from storage.

tools.name: music_play
tools.description: Plays music, songs, artists, or playlists on Spotify or default player.

tools.name: music_pause
tools.description: Pauses active audio playback.

tools.name: music_resume
tools.description: Resumes paused audio playback.

tools.name: music_next
tools.description: Skips to next track.

tools.name: music_previous
tools.description: Skips to previous track.

tools.name: music_open_spotify
tools.description: Opens the Spotify music player app.

tools.name: maps_navigate_to
tools.description: Opens turn-by-turn navigation in Google Maps to any destination address, business, or landmark.

tools.name: maps_search_nearby
tools.description: Searches for nearby points of interest like restaurants, gas stations, pharmacies, ATMs.

tools.name: maps_navigate_home
tools.description: Starts navigation to your home address.

tools.name: maps_open_app
tools.description: Opens Google Maps application.

tools.name: notes_create
tools.description: Creates and saves a quick note into memory.

tools.name: notes_list
tools.description: Retrieves all saved notes.

tools.name: list_add_item
tools.description: Adds an item to a named shopping or to-do list.

tools.name: list_view
tools.description: Views all items in a named list.

tools.name: reminder_create
tools.description: Creates a new reminder or to-do task with title and optional due time.

tools.name: reminder_list_today
tools.description: Lists all reminders scheduled for today.

tools.name: reminder_open_app
tools.description: Opens Google Tasks or the primary Reminders application.

tools.name: reminder_water_log
tools.description: Sets a periodic drinking water reminder.

tools.name: reminder_medicine_set
tools.description: Sets a daily reminder to take medicine.

tools.name: weather_current
tools.description: Retrieves current weather conditions, temperature, and summary for a location.

tools.name: weather_rain_check
tools.description: Checks if rain or precipitation is expected today in a location.

tools.name: weather_forecast_weekly
tools.description: Retrieves the 7-day extended weather forecast for a location.

tools.name: web_google_search
tools.description: Performs a Google web search for any query.

tools.name: web_open_url
tools.description: Opens a web link in browser.

tools.name: web_wikipedia_lookup
tools.description: Opens Wikipedia page for any topic or person.
